name: orchestrator_agent
description: A project management AI assistant that coordinates tasks, calendar, and notes by delegating to specialized sub-agents via A2A.

skills.name: Task Coordination
skills.description: Delegate task management operations (create, list, update, delete, semantic search, smart filter, summaries) to the Task Manager Agent.

skills.name: Calendar Management
skills.description: Delegate calendar operations (create events, list events, find free slots, delete events) to the Calendar Agent.

skills.name: Notes Management
skills.description: Delegate note operations (save, read, list, search notes) to the Notes Agent.

skills.name: Multi-Step Workflows
skills.description: Orchestrate complex requests across multiple agents, such as daily briefings, meeting follow-ups, and end-of-day wrap-ups.
